<p>This is an educational website for medical students, residents, and other learners interested in exploring pain medicine. Developed by McMaster medical students, the project aims to make learning about pain medicine more accessible and clinically relevant.</p>
<p>Much of the current material focuses on back pain, with an emphasis on building a foundation that learners can carry into clinical practice. Through learning modules and interactive cases, we hope to offer a resource that students can return to throughout their training.</p>
<p>Since the website is still in its early stages, we would greatly appreciate any feedback as we continue developing it. If you have any thoughts, ideas, or suggestions, please share them through the feedback form on our Help page!</p>
